jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 가설건축물 lane `building-permit-temporary-building` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_temporary_building already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows in one bucket and append to main only the rows it has not held and a removal marker per row it no longer holds (each row keyed by its SHA-256) (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Not enabled and never run as its unit in the journal (2026-10-16 to 2026-11-06); enabling it needs an attended run measured first (root ADR-0386 §3).

jobs.disabled_reason: New lane, never run as its unit: off until its first supervised run (runbooks/silver-refresh.md §3) has been timed within its time_limit_minutes and written to per_run_cap (root ADR-0386 §3); switching it on is a separate deploy step (ADR-0122 §4).

assets.title: 건축인허가 가설건축물
assets.description: 가설건축물 신고마다 한 행: 구조(컨테이너조·경량철골 등)·주용도(창고시설·공장·임시창고 등)·건축면적·연면적·지상층수·존치만료일. 공장 부지의 임시 창고·사무실이다. 한 허가에 여러 행이라 행 글자의 SHA-256 이 키다. 원문 23칸 보존. 읽는 소비자(필지 by-PNU 패널)는 다음 PR 이라 그때까지 섬으로 둔다(루트 ADR-0402).

dependencies.description: 가설건축물(mart_kcy_08) 23칸을 행마다 새 행·사라진 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; parcels since merged, split or recoded are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
